svg.title: Four candidate priors for the germination rate
svg.desc: Beta(1, 1), Beta(2, 2), Beta(16, 4) and Beta(4, 16) densities drawn on one axis over germination rates from 0 to 1, with a table of their means and prior strengths.
svg.text: Four defensible priors, before any seed is planted
Prior strength is a plus b, the count of prior observations a Beta prior is worth. Two of these priors are worth half a tray each.
